## Primaquine regimens by G6PD status

| G6PD status | Policy on PQ | Additional safety |
|---|---|---|
| **G6PD Normal** | PQ 0.25 mg/kg/day over 14 days | Counselling for adverse events |
| **G6PD Deficiency - Severe** | No PQ |  |
| **If no testing available** | PQ 0.25 mg/kg/day over 14 days | Take first dose & check urine color |
